title: Creation or Modification of Permissive RDP Rules in Firewall
id: 5a1e8f2c-1b2a-4f3d-8e4b-9c5d6e7f8a9b
description: Detects creation or modification of firewall rules allowing inbound RDP from broad source ranges (e.g., any, 0.0.0.0/0, /16 or larger).
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
logsource:
  category: firewall_configuration
  product: generic
detection:
  selection:
    action: ('create', 'modify')
    rule_name|contains: 'RDP'
    destination_port: 3389
    source_network: ('any', '0.0.0.0/0', '*')
    source_cidr|re: '/(0|8|1[0-6])$'
  condition: selection
level: high
